camel_example: aliyun eci DescribeContainerGroupEvents --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key test --EventSource K8sAgent --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-k' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000' --ContainerGroupIds 'eci-bp17gw49eu09yiwm0000_,_eci-bp19aq49du01abcm0000_,_eci-2zegym1qhbmdfr1s0000' --NextToken 'd78f2dd8-5979-42fe-xaee-b16db43be5bc' --VSwitchId 'vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000' --Tag.1.Value name --SinceSecond 60 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Limit 200
description_en: Queries events for multiple Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances in a batch
description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerGroupEvents批量查询ECI实例的事件信息
kebab_example: aliyun eci describe-container-group-events --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-k --vswitch-id vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000 --resource-group-id rg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --container-group-ids eci-bp17gw49eu09yiwm0000_,_eci-bp19aq49du01abcm0000_,_eci-2zegym1qhbmdfr1s0000 --tag Value=name Key=test --next-token d78f2dd8-5979-42fe-xaee-b16db43be5bc --event-source K8sAgent --since-second 60 --limit 200 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeContainerGroupEvents

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECI instances. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string
parameters.help_zh: ECI实例ID序列。最多20个，字符串需按照JSON格式传入
parameters.name: container_group_ids

element_fields.help_en: The tag value of the ECI instance
element_fields.name: value

element_fields.help_en: The tag key of the ECI instance
element_fields.name: key

parameters.help_en: The tags that are attached to the ECI instances
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to start the next query. If this parameter is left empty, no more data is returned.

You do not need to set this parameter for the first query. Obtain the token for subsequent queries from the response
parameters.help_zh:
下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。

首次查询时无需设置该参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The event source. Valid values:

EciService

K8sAgent

If you leave this parameter empty, all events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
事件源。取值范围：

EciService
K8sAgent

默认为空，查询所有事件
parameters.name: event_source

parameters.help_en: Returns only new events to enable incremental polling
parameters.help_zh: 返回最近几秒内新增的事件，用于轮询增量事件
parameters.name: since_second

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of ECI instances to return. Default value: 200.

The response may contain fewer entries than the specified value
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回资源（ECI实例）的数量。默认为200个。

返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit
